system.raises: +1 question each; Raises for clearer answers, old events, or waking idle kami (GM)
system.specialRules: Talk with a local kami of any element but Void; it answers 2 questions honestly as best it can.
Pick an element; learn how many of its kami are nearby and roughly where. Kansen are not detected.

system.raises: Range +10'; +1 cubic foot; 1-4 Raises (GM sets) for a specific material, never precious or jade
system.specialRules: Creates 1 cu. ft. of the element in open space in range; it acts normally. Not inside objects or creatures.
+15 Armor TN against non-magical ranged attacks while you concentrate.

entries.name: By the Light of the Moon

system.specialRules: Only you see non-magically hidden objects, compartments, and trapdoors in the area as faint glowing outlines.
An inanimate object no bigger than you turns invisible. Higher-Mastery detection sees it; equal Mastery: Contested Air.
A wind bird whispers your 1-minute message to a known target; any damage ends it; waits up to 1 week if blocked.
A natural animal (not Shadowlands or otherworldly) understands your words while you focus on it; no obedience.

system.raises: Cone +5' wide or +5' long; Damage +1k0; Knockdown contest +5 to your Air TN
system.specialRules: All in the cone take 1k1 Wounds and roll Earth in a contest vs your Air; each loser is Knocked Down.
Lifts temporary mental/social penalties from techniques, wounds, or spells; TN + source rank/Mastery. Not Disadvantages.
Stationary, intangible illusory object; vanishes if moved. Copying a known item: 1 Raise; owner rolls Perception vs it.

system.raises: +1 double per 2 Raises; Range +5'; 2 Raises: double holds its pose if you leave range
system.specialRules: An image of you appears in range and copies your actions; it vanishes once you leave range.

system.raises: +1k0 damage; +5 minutes; +5' range; 1 Raise: another spear
system.specialRules: Air spear DR 1k1; School Rank replaces Spears; with Spears, 1 Free Raise (Feint/Increased Damage). Ally in 20' can use.
Target's Social Skill roll totals gain +1k1 and your Air Ring.
Target flies: Free Moves only, no Simple Moves, max 10'/round; drifts down safely at the end. Strong wind hinders.

system.raises: 3 Raises: target another in sight; Duration +5 minutes
system.specialRules: Your face shifts so you pass as someone else of like age, build, race, and gender; cannot copy a specific person.
Stationary sight-only illusions of anything you imagine, fitting in the area; no sound or smell.
After a 10-minute ritual at a site, cast within 48 hours to hear speech there; one site at a time; lost focus ends it.
Creates a false sound or voice no louder than speech; a voice says 20 words at most and cannot mimic a given person.
Learn whether the target's latest statement was true; a sincerely held false belief reads as true.

system.raises: 2 Raises: target another; Duration +5 minutes; +1 Honor Rank per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Your Honor Rank counts as 3 higher against Lore: Bushido rolls that gauge your Honor.
You turn insubstantial: can't touch objects, pass solids at 1'/round, Water Ring halved (round down), no casting.
Look like any humanoid within 1' of your height (a kenku works; a goblin or ogre does not).
+20 Armor TN against melee and ranged attacks; you cannot hear speech meanwhile.
Fog cuts sight to 5' in the area; dampens fabric, may douse small flames (GM), ruins rice paper.
All within 30' of the target get +15 Armor TN vs ranged attacks and -3k3 on their own ranged attack rolls.
People within 20' of the subject don't notice them unless they make noise or draw notice; those farther see normally.
Target faces Fear 4 from an image of their worst fear; others see only a small haze.
Summon a spirit from any realm (Fortunes immune), a specific one if known; it can't attack unless you strike first.
Change how terrain in the area looks, sounds, and smells; the illusion has no substance.
Invisible to non-magical sight (still heard, smelled, touched); making an attack ends the spell.
Hear the target's surface thoughts; Contested Perception vs their Awareness reveals true emotions.
Create a working solid object, 1 or 2 hands, up to 20 lbs; a weapon deals damage. Vanishes at the end.
Passers roll Earth vs your Air; losers roll Willpower vs your casting total or sleep 1 hour (harm wakes). One at a time.
Contested Air vs target's Earth: they lose the last 5 days of memory and accept your version of events.
Dispels illusions of Mastery 4 or less; Mastery 5-6 need Contested Air; other effects: your Air vs caster's Ring.
Two-way whispered link with someone you know, any distance, while you concentrate; either side may end it.
Chosen people in the area turn invisible to normal senses; one who physically touches an outsider drops out.
Deals (Air+2)kAir to all in the corridor; those hit roll Earth TN 20 or are Knocked Down; shreds paper and light cloth.
Kami: Physical Traits = Air, Jiujitsu Air/2, DR AirkAir, Wounds as Earth=Air, Invulnerable; blocks Simple Moves in 20'.
Up to Air x 10 mobile figures of types you know; seen, heard, smelled, but intangible; they stay in the area.
Hurricane up to 1 hour, calm 20' eye; exposed take 1k1 Wounds/minute, 10% chance of 5k5 instead. Once a month per area.
Reduction = Earth Ring + School Rank; Water counts 1 lower for movement.
+5k0 vs Fear (+3k0 outside the Seven Great Clans); no benefit at Taint Rank 1+. Combined ritual allowed.
Target takes -2k0 on Agility rolls; Water counts 1 lower for movement.
+1 to one Earth Trait of the caster's choice; the Earth Ring itself is unchanged.
Pick an Element (not Void or Maho): its spells on the target take +School Rank x 5 TN, friendly ones too.
3k3 damage to a target with Taint Rank 1+, none otherwise. Cannot be intercepted or deflected.
Re-roll a failed Stamina roll vs poison at +2k0; cures and prevents drunkenness.
Binds a Tainted Shadowlands creature of Earth 3 or less, helpless; not the Lost or Oni Lords.
+3k0 to resist manipulation, Temptation, Compulsions; -1k0 on Awareness rolls to influence others.

system.raises: +1k0 damage; +5 minutes duration; +5' range; 1 Raise: other heavy weapon form
system.specialRules: 2k2 tetsubo; School Rank may replace Heavy Weapons; with that Skill, Free Raise on Knockdown. May go to an ally.
Willing ally gains Reduction 5 x School Rank (max 20); no Simple Move Actions while it lasts.

system.raises: +1k0 damage; +1 target; 2 Raises: boulders count as Jade
system.specialRules: Boulder damage with DR equal to Earth Ring; -1k1 per extra target (min 1k1).
Target moves through earth like air and sees 100 yards; no outside interaction; surfacing ends it.
Target ignores Wound Rank penalties and effects, even death at Out; all apply when it ends.

system.raises: +1 round duration; +5' range; +1 target per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Target moves only 3' per Simple Move; escape with a Complex Action Raw Strength roll vs TN Earth x 5.
Climb walls at half speed (round up); on ceilings 3' per Simple Action. May fall when it ends.
+3k0 vs Knockdown; spells to lift or topple target need a Contested Element roll vs caster's Earth.

system.raises: +1 minute duration; +5' range; +1 target per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Target's Rings and Traits cannot be raised or lowered by any effect.

system.raises: +1 day duration; +10' range; +1 target per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: 10-minute ritual (-1 minute per helper, min 1): bind a spirit-realm creature to obey, or banish it.
+2 Wounds at each Wound Rank; +1k1 on Earth, Stamina, Willpower rolls; Wounds taken remain at the end.

system.raises: +5' radius per 2 Raises (max 30'); 2 Raises: extra -1k1 damage
system.specialRules: Hostile Air, Fire, Water spells in the area: +10 TN to cast; their damage -1k1 (min 1k1).
1-hour ritual removes Taint from land, plants, objects (not creatures); afterward +15 TN to cast spells there.
Each target adds the group's lowest Earth Ring to Ring, Trait, Skill roll totals (not Spell Casting).
+5k5 to resist gaining new Taint from outside; Maho takes +10 TN against the target.
Earth Ring -1 (Wounds shrink) and Strength -1; a Tainted target loses 2 Earth instead (min 1).
Each damage die from enemy attacks is reduced by School Rank (min 0).

system.raises: +1 round duration; +5' range; +1 target per 2 Raises; +1 Earth per 2 Raises (max +3)
system.specialRules: Earth Ring +1 with matching Wounds; Wounds revert when it ends, which may kill.
Passers: Air vs caster's Earth; losers roll Strength vs casting total or are Prone and Stunned; Tainted take 2k2.

system.raises: +10' range; +1k1 to caster's Contested roll per Raise
system.specialRules: Tainted target only. Contested Earth each round: caster wins, 2k2 Wounds; target wins, spell ends.

system.raises: +1' height or +10' width per Raise; +1 minute duration; +10' range
system.specialRules: Breaking through needs a Strength roll vs TN (Earth + School Rank) x 5.

system.raises: +500 yards area; +1 minute duration per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Others in area: Prone, Stunned, 2k1 Wounds; anyone indoors (caster too) takes 6k6. Wooden buildings fall.
10-minute ritual (-1 minute per helper); combined Earth vs target's Earth; a win binds a Lost or Tainted being.

system.raises: +1 round duration; +10' range; +1 target per 2 Raises; +1k1 to Contested roll per Raise
system.specialRules: Contested Earth; on a loss the target's Earth Ring drops to 1 (Wounds shrink, may kill).
Reduction 20; Strength and one more physical Trait + caster's Earth; no Simple Move Actions.
X = caster's Earth: Willpower +X; non-Maho spells on target -XkX; target -Xk0 on Social Skill rolls.

system.raises: +1 round duration; +5' range; +1 target per 2 Raises (max 3)
system.specialRules: Target cannot gain Taint and is immune to Maho. Fails on, and reveals, a target with Taint Rank 1+.

system.raises: +1 minute duration; +10' range; +1 target; +10 Wounds absorbed per Raise
system.specialRules: Absorbs all damage to each target until 100 Wounds absorbed; nemuranai bypass it.

system.raises: +5' range; +1k1 to caster's Contested roll per Raise
system.specialRules: Needs a gem or pearl. Contested Willpower; a win traps a Jigoku, Gaki-do, Toshigoku, or Tainted creature.
Earth kami: Physical Traits = Earth, Jiujitsu half Earth, DR = Earth, Invulnerable; no Simple Moves within 20'.
A non-magical steel blade gains +1k1 DR.
+1k1 to melee attack rolls; +2k2 vs mounted or larger-than-human foes. Ends if the weapon is dropped.
2k2 Wounds, never misses. A shugenja hit mid-cast rolls Willpower vs TN 20 + damage.
Puts out non-magical fire; fire damage is -1k1 DR until the next round starts.
Touching or meleeing the target costs 2k2 Wounds; target's melee hits deal +2k2. Ranged attacks unaffected.
Outdoors only. 5k2 Wounds (6k2 or 6k3 in storms); within 10' Stamina TN 15 or deafened 2 rounds.

system.raises: +1k0 damage; +5 minutes duration; +5' range; 1 Raise: another sword form
system.specialRules: 2k2 katana; School Rank may replace Kenjutsu; with Kenjutsu add Honor Rank to damage. May go to an ally.
+Fire Ring to attack, Skill, Trait rolls until a failed attack or Skill roll, or any Wounds.
Everyone in area, caster too, takes Fire Ring DR (one roll); the caster takes half, rounded up.
Removes cracks, nicks, and blemishes from an ordinary-quality item; cannot fix broken items.
Magical healing of the target automatically fails; Medicine still works.
3k2 Wounds to all in the area on casting; 2k1 more at the start of each later round they stay.
Next Fire spell casts 4 rounds faster; Mastery 3 or less is a Simple Action. Start it within 2 rounds.
Whoever carries the item gains +3 Intelligence.
Melee attackers of the wearer are Fatigued until their next Turn; Full Attack drops to Attack.
Flame whip reaching 30': attack (Agility + 2 x School Rank)kAgility, DR equal to Fire Ring.
Fireball dealing damage with DR equal to Fire Ring.
Tainted or Lying Darkness beings need Contested Willpower (you +5) to enter; Fire + Insight Wounds per round.
Simple Action once per round: breathe fire at all in area, DR = Fire Ring. No speech or casting.
Flammable material burns to ash; only magic puts it out. One structure; living beings unharmed.
Locked in Full Attack Stance; out of combat gains Brash and Contrary. Resist: Willpower vs your roll + Fire.
Wielder +1k0 to attack; damage dice explode on 8+ (once per die on an 8 or 9).
4k3 Wounds; if the target casts a Fire spell meanwhile, it fails and he takes 3k3.
Each melee attacker of the wearer takes 2k2 Wounds, Blinded through to that round's Reactions Stage.
Damage DR equal to Fire Ring to all in area; flimsy or flammable buildings are destroyed or burn.
Agility and Intelligence -Fire Ring (min 1). Without Concentration, target may roll Contested Fire each turn.
Wearer's Armor TN +20; wooden weapons and arrows burn up before hitting, dealing no damage.
Passers roll Water vs caster's Fire; losers are Dazed, Blinded 1 round, take 3k3. One Symbol at a time.
1-minute casting, all pieces present: restores an item; Fine or nemuranai items need an offering to burn.

system.raises: Per Raise: +10' height, +1' thickness, or +25' length
system.specialRules: 10' x 1' x 25' wall, 6k6 Wounds on touch; those in its spot roll Reflexes TN 20 to avoid.
Within 15': immune to non-magical fire and thunder; others' Fire spells into the area +20 TN.
7k7 Wounds to everyone in the area except the caster, allies included.
Target counts as at the Down Wound Rank with its penalties, without taking Wounds.
Each round send fire at a visible target within 300' (75'/round): 6k5, then half each round while burning.
2k2/round in area; humans +2k1 per Honor Rank below 4, +2k2 if Tainted; Honor 0 Blinded Fire Ring rounds.
Fly: Water x 10 as a Free Action, Water x 20 as a Simple Action; set down safely when it ends.
10k10 Wounds to one target.
Buildings in area immune to magical fire; Fire spells cast there +15 TN; normal fire spreads slowly.
Weapon overcomes Invulnerability; anyone it hits is Stunned.

system.raises: +1k0 damage; +5 minutes; +5' range; 1 Raise: another staff form
system.specialRules: Staff DR 1k2; School Rank may replace Staves; Staves users get 1 Free Raise for Knockdown. Ally in 20' may wield it.
Allies in the area add +5 to their Initiative Score.
Shift up to School Rank of one Physical Trait from you to target (max 2x rank). At 0 you pass out; lasts 1 round.
Heals Wounds equal to the casting roll's margin over its TN.
Reveals every power of the object (nemuranai, curse, scroll's spell) and a rough history. Ciphers stay unread.
Once per round the target may reroll one roll right after making it, keeping either result.
Target's max movement per round becomes Water x 20' + 2x caster's Water. Grants no extra actions.

system.raises: Range +5'; 5 Raises: extra action is Complex
system.specialRules: Target gains 1 extra Simple Action in this round's Reactions Stage; it cannot be an attack.

system.raises: Range +5'; 3 Raises: move an effect between two other willing targets
system.specialRules: Move one spell effect currently on you to a willing target. Unwilling targets never qualify.
Target's Free Move covers Water x 10' instead of x 5'; must be used next Turn unless Duration is raised.
Armor TN + (Water Ring + School Rank).

system.raises: +1 person fed per Raise; Raises can improve food quality (GM)
system.specialRules: Food and drink for School Rank + 1 people for one day. Casting TN doubled in the Shadowlands.
Watch a familiar place (lived there or meditated 10+ min) through any water; sight only, no sound.
Rested as after a full night: clears fatigue, restores Void-Ring spell slots; not Void Points or daily powers. 1/24 hrs.
Target gains a Simple Action (attack only) in this round's Reactions Stage, Complex if needed. Never a second spell.
Learn direction and rough distance to one familiar object in range.
Water counts +2 for Move Action distance this round and next.
Read twice as fast with perfect recall of the text; no help with unknown languages or ciphers.
Target ignores current Wound penalties; later penalties apply only the amount above the ignored one. No healing.
Target heals Water + School Rank Wounds each round; touch needed only at casting.
Store a second spell (ML 3 or less, any element) that fires on a physical trigger you name. One stored spell at a time.

system.aoe: Cone, 10' wide at the far end
system.raises: Damage +1k0; Range +5'; Earth Roll TN +5 per Raise
system.specialRules: 3k3 Wounds to all in the cone; opponents roll Earth vs TN 15 or are Knocked Down.
Gaze into a large still pool for a symbolic but accurate glimpse of coming events; only you see it.
Target walks on water as Basic Terrain; rough or stormy water is Difficult Terrain.

system.raises: Water counts 1 rank higher per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Target rolls extra dice equal to your Water on every Perception-based roll.
Look out of any known water in range via a pool at least 1' wide and 1" deep; sight only.

system.raises: +1 round of duration for every 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Chosen allies' Water x 10' move takes a Free Action, not a Simple one.
Each time a target takes damage, it heals 1k1 Wounds.
Ignore foe Armor TN boosts from armor, ML 1-3 spells, non-Technique effects (unarmored -5); not stances/Reduction.
Ward on a passage: crossers make Contested Fire vs your Water or face Fear 7. One per caster; another casting dispels.
Move unused spell slots from one chosen Ring to another for one day.
Take a natural creature's shape: keep your Mental Traits, best of each Physical Trait, gain its natural abilities.

system.aoe: Up to Water Ring willing targets
system.specialRules: Swap places among the chosen willing targets; every starting spot stays occupied.
1-hr ritual, willing: no food/sleep, School Rank Void refills, heal 2x Water/hr, slots at dawn; exhausted half as long.
Target acts as Down; Stamina TN 15 each round: 3 successes recover, 2 straight fails = unconscious, dies in 1 min.
Learn rough location of one very familiar object or close person anywhere in Rokugan; fails outside it.
Cures all diseases and poisons and heals every Wound.
Summons a water kami: Physical Traits = Water, Jiujutsu = half Water, DR = Water, Invulnerable, moves 15' x Water.
Ask one question; the water answers with three images that onlookers can also see.
See and hear a place you have visited, undetected; your Armor TN drops to 5 meanwhile.
Gain School Rank + 1 Void Points; any above your max fade 1 per round you spend none.
Turn the affected water, fire, air, or soil into one other element.

system.raises: Range +5'; +1 Advantage or Disadvantage per Raise
system.specialRules: Learn the target's highest-point Advantage or Disadvantage (your pick).
Trance: sense where every living creature in the area is; spirits and Shadowlands beings show as gaps.
Suppress one Mental or Spiritual Disadvantage worth up to 5 points; Taint itself cannot be removed.
1k1 damage and the target is Dazed.
While delaying, you may interrupt the target after it declares but before it acts, once each round.
You may spend several Void Points on one roll (only rolls that allow Void; never damage).
Learn the target's Rings, current Wound penalty, and present mood in one word.
Target repeats the next sentence you speak in its own voice; works once, and cannot cast spells.
Move a small object at range without touching it.
Target must win a Contested Void Roll vs you (once per turn, no action) to spend Void Points.
Cast other-element spells of ML 1-2 with no spoken prayer.
While you concentrate on the target, you hear its thoughts.
Pool Void Points with one willing target; either may spend them. Split back at the end, up to each max.
Pick a Skill: you have ranks equal to your Void Ring, replacing (not adding to) your own.
Vision of the object's last holder or a major event tied to it; GM decides. Key items may hold you longer.
Contested Void: steal 1 Void Point, +1 per 5 you win by; extras over max lapse in 1 hour. Target needs Void.

system.raises: Duration +1 round or +1 minute; +1k1 healing per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Suppress all Disadvantages and penalties from spells of ML 3 or less; heals 3k3 Wounds.
Banish a non-Ningen-do spirit home for Void Ring months; embodied spirits get a Contested Willpower Roll.
Target regains all spent Void Points, up to max.
Damage roll with DR = Void Ring.
Exist in two spots in sight, both acting; one Spell Casting Roll per round; Wounds add up; if one dies, both do.
Turn one uniform, non-living object into another of similar size; a second casting reverses it.
Target's Rings, with their paired Traits, are shuffled at random.
Commune with the Void Dragon and ask questions; it may not answer. Learned by insight, no scroll.
Revert target to its state 8 hours earlier (wounds, poison, Taint); not the dead. You lose all Void Points for 3 days.
Destroy the target: creatures need Contested Void vs Earth, mundane objects always; nemuranai risky (GM).
Wounded target only. 1 Wound at start of each of its Turns; ends on Medicine (Wound Treatment)/Int TN 20 or full heal.

system.raises: Area +5' radius each; Duration +2 rounds each
system.specialRules: Fixed zone: all inside but the caster are Blind. Only anti-blindness magic or Shadowlands powers see through.

system.raises: Duration +2 minutes each; Special: heal 1k0 more each
system.specialRules: Heals 1k1 Wounds; one physical Trait (caster picks) +1 Rank for duration. Target gains 1k1 Taint. Wounds can drop after.
Chosen arm or leg: +15 TN to physical actions using it. A leg also inflicts the Lame Disadvantage.

system.raises: Duration +10 minutes; Range +10'; Targets +1 (each per Raise)
system.specialRules: Target gains a 3-point Phobia of the caster's choosing for the duration.

system.raises: Duration +1 round each; Targets +1 each; +1 Void Point lost per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Target is stripped of 1 Void Point, which stays unrecoverable until the spell ends.

system.raises: Range +50' each; +1 Free Raise granted per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Sleeping or resting target. For 24 hours after, caster has 1 Free Raise on Temptation and Intimidation against it.

system.raises: +1 hour of Duration per 2 Raises; Range +20' each; +1 corpse each
system.specialRules: Animates a corpse as a zombie (Book of Void p.331) obeying simple orders; collapses at spell end or if destroyed.
Hidden blood message reappears when caster's condition is met; only magic detects it. Expires unread after duration.
Destroys one visible jade object, leaving black slime. No effect on awakened nemuranai.

system.raises: +1 day of Duration per 2 Raises (max 7); +1 target per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Victim cannot sleep, so no Void or spell slot recovery. Daily Raw Stamina vs TN 5 + 5 per sleepless night or Fatigued.

system.raises: Duration +2 rounds each; Range +10' each; +1 target per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: +10 TN to all physical and mental Skill/Trait rolls, Spell Casting included; Armor TN -10.

system.raises: Duration +2 minutes; Range +10'; Targets +1 (each per Raise); -1 more Stamina per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Stamina -1 (minimum 1) for the duration; may lower Earth and so Wounds per rank.

system.raises: Duration +1 round each; Range +5' each; +1 target per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Target falls Prone and loses its next Turn. Willpower TN 20 or cries out, risking Honor/Glory.

system.raises: Duration +2 hours; Range +20'; +1 undead (each per Raise)
system.specialRules: Control undead: free mindless ones automatic; free-willed or controlled need Contested Willpower vs it or master.
Shift up to Earth + Insight Rank Taint from Tainted target to other; last point stays. Unwilling: Contested Willpower.

system.aoe: One person or creature, or self
system.raises: Duration +5 minutes each; +1 spell negated per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Negates the next Jade-keyword spell that strikes or affects the target, then ends.
Living target. If it dies in duration, revives 8 hours later at Down, +1 Taint Rank, unless body scattered or burned.
Animates an Undead Revenant (Book of Void p.330) that obeys spoken commands until destroyed.

system.raises: +1 round of Duration per 2 Raises; Range +10' each
system.specialRules: Victim must attack whoever it faces at casting. Each Turn, Honor TN 30 to resist, but then only Free/Simple Actions.

system.raises: +1k0 to the control roll each; stronger oni (GM)
system.specialRules: Oni must be named (caster or close tie), then Contested Willpower to control; +3k2 if own name. Namer gets Oni Mark.

system.raises: Duration +5 minutes; Range +10'; +1k0 to hold roll (each per Raise)
system.specialRules: Living target only: immobile and helpless, may still speak. Escapes via Strength vs caster's Earth contested roll.

system.raises: Damage +1k0 each; Range +20' each; +1 target per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: DR = target's Air in kept dice, plus +10 TN to all actions until healed by magic, kiho, or other supernatural means.

system.raises: +1 more Trait Rank drained per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: Needs a token of the target; ritual allowed. -1 Rank to a chosen Trait (min 1); each extra caster drains another Trait.

system.raises: Duration +2 minutes; Range +10'; Targets +1 (each per Raise)
system.specialRules: Target cannot lie and spills harmful secrets; Willpower TN 30 to hold back the truth.

system.raises: +1 day of Duration per 2 Raises; +25' Range each; +1k0 to the Willpower contest each
system.specialRules: Needs target's name and blood or hair. Contested Willpower: win: control body (own mental stats); lose: 2k1 Wounds.

system.raises: Duration +1 round each; +1 Rank to a physical Trait per 2 Raises
system.specialRules: +1 Earth Ring and +1 to the other three physical Traits; sees through any visual impairment. Wounds drop at end.
Target takes 7k7 Wounds and ages 10 years; the aging is permanent.
